bundles.name: YouTube Export Presets
bundles.description: Optimized export settings for 1080p, 4K, and Shorts uploads to YouTube. Tuned for compression efficiency without sacrificing visible quality.

bundles.name: Client Delivery LUTs
bundles.description: Color grading LUTs matched to common client delivery specs. Rec.709 conversions for cinematic, broadcast, and web outputs.

bundles.name: Podcast Audio Chain
bundles.description: Voice processing chain — EQ, compression, de-esser, and limiter — calibrated for clear dialogue on episodic content. Drops into Premiere's Effects Presets folder.

bundles.name: Social Media Templates
bundles.description: Motion graphics templates for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. Title cards, lower thirds, end screens.

bundles.name: Resolve Cinematic LUTs
bundles.description: Cinematic color grading LUTs for DaVinci Resolve. Includes warm, cool, bleach bypass, and teal/orange variations.

bundles.name: Signature PowerGrades
bundles.description: Milestone Creative Media's signature color grades for DaVinci Resolve. Requires manual import via the Color page Gallery.
bundles.importInstructions: Open Resolve, go to the Color page, open the Gallery panel, right-click in the PowerGrades album, and choose Import. Select all files in the synced folder.

bundles.name: Fairlight Voice Presets
bundles.description: Audio processing presets for the Fairlight page in DaVinci Resolve. EQ and dynamics chains for dialogue.
